description:
hello, and welcome to vlog 62!
this week, i am back with a slower paced, calm vlog (that ended up being my longest video yet!)
with all of the overwhelming content and fast paced living in this world, i've been inspired to slow down and get back in touch with each moment. as i've been working on this, i wanted to create a video for you all to do the same! a space where we can all relax, set aside some quiet time, and live in the moment. so, i hope you'll enjoy these days with me as i do some cleaning, unpacking, cooking and making drinks, reading, planning with my favorite stationery, etc.
may we all remember to slow down, enjoy the little things, and see rest as a productive and important part of life too. thank you always for being here, and don't forget to take care of yourselves! grab a snack, drink some water, and do something you love
until next time ~

영상 속 주인공은 미국의 전설적인 배우이자 가수, 뮤지컬 배우인 셰릴 리 랄프(Sheryl Lee Ralph)입니다. 1981년 브로드웨이 뮤지컬 드림걸즈(Dreamgirls)의 오리지널 디나 존스 역으로 토니상 후보에 오르며 큰 명성을 얻었으며, 오랜 기간 스크린과 무대를 넘나들며 탄탄한 연기력을 인정받았습니다. 최근에는 ABC의 히트 시트콤 애보트 초등학교(Abbott Elementary)에서 베테랑 교사 바바라 하워드 역을 완벽히 소화하며 대중과 평단의 뜨거운 사랑을 받고 있습니다.

2. 영상 비하인드 & 배경
본 영상은 제28회 크리틱스 초이스 어워즈(Critics Choice Awards)에서 셰릴 리 랄프가 애보트 초등학교로 TV 코미디 부문 여우조연상을 수상했을 당시의 소감입니다. 오랜 커리어 끝에 시상대 중심에 선 그녀가 전 세계 시청자들을 향해 뿜어내는 당당함과 진정성 어린 목소리는 현장의 배우들뿐만 아니라 수많은 대중에게 깊은 울림과 전율을 선사했습니다.

3. 핵심 발언 및 메시지
셰릴 리 랄프는 타인의 인정과 사랑, 심지어는 존중마저도 구걸할 필요가 없다고 단호하게 말합니다. 세상이 나를 어떻게 바라보고 평가하든지 간에 가장 중요한 것은 '나 자신과의 관계'라는 점을 강조합니다. 세상 모든 사람이 나를 외면할지라도, 거울 속에 비친 자신의 모습을 온전히 인정하고 깊이 사랑할 수 있는 단단한 내면을 가질 것을 당부하는 주체적인 자존감의 메시지입니다.

4. 추천 영어 표현 및 소통
이 영상에서는 강한 권유나 당부를 나타내는 핵심 표현인 "You better + 동사원형" 패턴을 배울 수 있습니다. 보통 경고의 의미로 자주 쓰이지만, 여기서는 "반드시 ~해야 한다", "~하는 것이 좋을 것이다"라는 확신에 찬 조언과 격려로 사용되었습니다.
* 표현 예시: You better love what you see. (당신이 보는 모습을 반드시 사랑해야 합니다.)
*  거울 속 당신의 모습 중 오늘 가장 칭찬해 주고 싶은 부분은 무엇인가요? 댓글로 여러분의 당당한 한마디를 공유해 주세요!

5. 가이드라인 준수 및 교육적 목적
본 영상은 대중문화 전반에 긍정적인 영향력을 미친 셀럽의 주요 발언을 소개하고, 유용한 영어 표현 및 번역을 제공함으로써 시청자들의 언어 학습과 인성 함양을 돕기 위한 교육적·공익적 목적으로 제작되었습니다. 유튜브 커뮤니티 가이드라인을 엄격히 준수하며, 어떠한 자극적이거나 부적절한 표현도 포함하고 있지 않습니다.

Inside Denver International Airport - Secrets, History, and Behind the Scenes
description:
Take a rare behind the scenes tour of Denver International Airport and discover its hidden history, massive operations, and the secrets that keep it running smoothly.

Join host Matthew Burchette as he uncovers the fascinating story of Denver's airports, from the early days of Stapleton to the world-class Denver International Airport (DIA). You'll get an exclusive look at rare artifacts, historic renderings, and interviews with key figures whose families shaped Denver aviation. Explore how DIA handles over 60 million passengers a year, the cutting-edge automated TSA screening lanes, and why the airport was built so far from downtown. 

Venture onto the airfield with the Director of Operations to learn about the airport's six runways - including North America's longest commercial runway - and see how the ramp tower keeps traffic moving safely 24/7. Meet the legendary snow removal team and discover the specialized equipment and strategies that keep runways clear, even during the fiercest Colorado storms. Dive into the economic impact of DIA, its future expansion plans, and get the inside scoop on the infamous underground tunnels (and those lizard man legends!). 

Whether you're an aviation enthusiast, a frequent flyer, or just curious about airport logistics, this deep dive behind the wings of Denver International Airport will amaze you with stories, technology, and the dedicated people making it all happen.

description:
Title: Ice Scream 5 Friends: Mike | Full Gameplay Walkthrough | 2025

#gameplay #horrorgame #scary #scarygame #games #icecreamhorrorgame 

ABOUT THIS GAME:
Mike reaches the engine room and joins the mission to escape the factory.

In the previous chapter, you freed your friends from their cages, stopping them from ending up in the extraction room. But you couldn't get them very far, because Rod showed up at the last minute and they had to go back into hiding. Your friends are now in different parts of this huge ice cream factory. You need to get them all together and defeat Rod, the evil ice-cream man, once and for all.
In this new installment, you’ll begin playing as Mike. For the first time, you’ll be able to switch players and become J. again whenever you need to. Explore the new parts of the factory in this chapter, face the Mini-Rods, the ice-cream man and reunite Mike and J.
Pre-register now and you’ll get a secret key that will allow you to unlock a special item on the game’s release.

Features:
★ character switching system: for the first time in the series, you can switch between playing as Mike or J, allowing you to play in different areas, depending on the character.
★ New enemy: confront this chapter’s new Mini Rod. The ice cream factory guards who will try to stop you from running away and will alert Rod if they see you. Show off your skills by dodging and escaping them.
★ Fun puzzles: solve ingenious puzzles to be reunited with your friends.
★ Mini game: complete this chapter’s most exciting puzzle in the form of a mini game.
★ Cinematic narratives: travel back in time and relive key moments in the history of Rod and Joseph Sullivan.
★ Original soundtrack: immerse yourself in the Ice Scream universe with unique music playing to the beat of the saga and voices recorded exclusively for the game.
★ Hint system: if you get stuck, you have an elaborate hint window at your disposal that’s full of options to help you solve the puzzles based on your playstyle.
★ Various difficulty levels: play at your own pace and explore safely in ghost mode, or confront Rod and his assistants in the various difficulty levels that will put your skills to the test.
★ A terrifyingly fun game suitable for all audiences!

If you want to enjoy an experience of fantasy, horror and fun, play "Ice Scream 5 Friends: Mike's Adventures". Action and scares guaranteed.
Playing with headphones is recommended for the best experience.

description:
Confused about American Mahjong scoring? In this video, I walk through exactly how to score a game using National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) tournament-style scoring rules.

We’ll cover:

• How points are awarded when a player wins a hand
• Bonus points for self-picked mahjong (drawing the winning tile from the wall)
• Bonus points for jokerless hands
• How scoring changes when the winning tile comes from a discard
• Penalties assessed to the player who discarded the winning tile
• How wall games are scored
• Common scoring scenarios every American Mahjong player should know

Whether you’re playing casually with friends, participating in a club tournament, or preparing for competitive NMJL play, understanding scoring can add a whole new layer of strategy and excitement to your game.

I also share how to use our Southern Sparrow Tournament Scorecard Pad, designed to make tracking scores simple, organized, and fun for league play, tournaments, card parties, and friendly competitions.

If you’ve ever wondered:
 • How do you score American Mahjong?

 • How many bonus points do you get for a jokerless hand?

This video answers all of those questions.

title: God Of War 2 - Game Review
description:
God of War II improves massively on gameplay and scale, and that’s ultimately what carries the experience. Combat feels refined, more aggressive, and far more ambitious than the first game, making it one of the strongest action titles of its time.

Story-wise, however, it doesn’t hit quite as hard as the original. While the reveal of Kratos’ lineage is important and impactful, much of the narrative takes a back seat to spectacle and action. The game clearly prioritizes gameplay evolution over emotional depth, and for the most part, that decision works.

God of War II may not surpass the original in storytelling, but as a pure action game, it sets a new standard and solidifies the series’ identity.

title: Miley Cyrus explains how Jimmy Fallon assisted her in quitting marijuana | #shorts #mileycyrus
description:
Miley Cyrus revealed that she had stopped smoking weed in a recent interview with Jimmy Fallon on "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon" and gave Jimmy credit for encouraging her to do so.

The "Wrecking Ball" hitmaker and former Disney Channel star had previously been outspoken about her marijuana use, frequently discussing it in interviews and even dedicating a song to it on her 2013 album "Bangerz." She appears to have turned a new leaf, though, and decided to give up that habit.

Miley acknowledged during her appearance on Jimmy Fallon that she had given up smoking marijuana for several weeks, and she attributed her decision to the talk show host. She explained that Jimmy had advised her to stop smoking and concentrate on her music during a previous appearance on the show.

Miley continued by stating that she had followed his advice and was currently feeling more productive and focused than ever. She also mentioned how she could now sleep better and had more energy all day.

The singer's decision to give up smoking has been applauded by her supporters, many of whom have posted messages of encouragement on social media. Some people have even commended Miley for her efforts and shared their own stories of quitting smoking.

It's crucial to remember that giving up smoking can be challenging, and Miley's choice to do so is a personal one. But it's encouraging to see her improving herself and concentrating on her objectives.

Overall, Miley's appearance on Jimmy Fallon was a great reminder that making changes in your life is never too late and that having a strong support system can make all the difference. We wish Miley the best of luck as she works toward living a healthier and happier life.

description:
Own The Starving Games on DVD on 1/21/14!  http://amzn.to/19gTzQZ

Set in the most depressing corner of a post-apocalyptic future, our hero Kantmiss Evershot (Maiara Walsh) volunteers to take her manipulative younger sister's place in the 75th annual "Starving Games." In doing so, she must leave behind her smoldering just-a-friend Dale (Brant Daugherty) and team up with the geeky baker's son Peter Malarkey (Cody Allen Christian) in a fight for her life.  But wait, there's more!  She could also win an old ham, a coupon for a footlong sub at a six-inch price, and a partially-eaten pickle!
 
In The Starving Games, Friedberg and Seltzer's sixth cinematic spoof of popular box-office hits, the prolific parody duo has its sights trained on the adventure blockbuster The Hunger Games!  It's all the laughs and half the calories as they sling dozens of cock-eyed, barbed arrows at sci-fi, action and fantasy films from The Avengers and Oz the Great and Powerful to pop culture characters and celebrities like Harry Potter and Taylor Swift.

Rated PG-13 for crude and sexual content, comic violence, language and partial nudity.

that scene in Three Idiots, where you all had to drink a little bit. Yeah. Were you all actually drunk? Totally. Totally. But like I say, not passed out. But we in Maa... So Aamir Khan's idea was... Collect layers in running game & build the biggest slinky toy to beat the giant!

Yo, check it out! Layer Man is an insanely exciting hyper-casual mobile game that guarantees players an entertaining and addictive experience. The game is all about a stickman runner who races through a crowded runway to collect as many hoops as possible without hitting any obstacles.

One of the most awesome things about the game is how simple it is. All you gotta do is collect layers scattered throughout the runway to build a slinky toy. The more layers you collect, the longer the slinky toy becomes, which can give you a sweet boost on the final stage of the level. It's easy to understand, but challenging to master, which keeps things interesting.

As you're running through the runway, you gotta navigate through various obstacles to avoid collisions. If you bump into an obstacle, you lose some hoops, which ain't cool for your overall score. That's why it's crucial to keep collecting hoops and dodging obstacles like a boss.

And to make things even more exciting, Layer Man has multiple levels with increasing difficulty. You gotta step up your game and navigate through these levels, collecting layers and avoiding obstacles like a pro, to become one of the masters of the game.

But wait, there's more! Layer Man isn't just a fun game to play. It also tests your reflexes, concentration, and agility. As you progress through the game, you gotta hone these skills to succeed, which is a dope opportunity to boost your attributes.

The graphics of Layer Man are visually appealing, with vibrant colors and a smooth interface, making it an enjoyable experience for players of all ages. The game's design is both fun and intuitive, which makes it easy to pick up and play for anyone who's interested.

So, what are you waiting for? Download Layer Man now and put your running skills to the test. Collect as many layers as you can, avoid obstacles, and win the game! Whether you're looking for a fun way to pass the time or you're an experienced gamer, Layer Man is sure to provide you with hours of entertainment.

Establishing himself as one of music’s most exciting new voices, Bailey Zimmerman strikes a sweet spot between timeless American country, rafter-rattling arena rock, and authentic storytelling. It’s why in just one year’s time, he’s already logged over 400 million global streams, notched two entries on the Billboard Hot 100, and immediately sold out his first headline tour. Growing up in the small town of Louisville, IL, Zimmerman embraced country music on long-haul truck rides with his dad, and 80’s hair rock at home with his mom. By the time he hit high school, Zimmerman learned old school American values of hard work and dependability through a gig at the local meat market and long hours on a union gas pipeline. Simultaneously, he discovered his natural musical talent and began to sing whenever there was a guitar nearby. After a garage-recorded demo of his song “Never Comin’ Home” amassed over a million plays overnight, he turned in his union card to fulfill a growing demand for new music. Zimmerman fueled his meteoric rise with anthemic singles including, “Fall In Love”, “Rock and A  Hard Place”, and “Where It Ends”. Phil Hanley began standup comedy by performing at open mics around Vancouver, often in between bands at music venues.  In these establishments he discovered and honed his unique blending of material and crowd interaction that makes no two of his performances the same. Phil’s style can best be described as unpredictably reflective, delivered with sharp accuracy, and rooted in the grand tradition of joke-telling.

Phil's Comedy Central "The Half Hour" premiered November 14, 2015.  Phil has previously been seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, Late Night with Seth Meyers, The Late Late Show With Craig Ferguson, The Pete Holmes Show, John Oliver’s New York Stand-Up Show, and @midnight. Follow Dr. Paul Massimiano, MD, a thoracic and cardiac surgeon, through a day in his life at Adventist HealthCare White Oak Medical Center in Silver Spring, Maryland USA.

ABOUT DR. MASSIMIANO
Paul Massimiano, MD, is board certified in Cardiothoracic Surgery and Surgery and he has a distinguished career in cardiac surgery spanning more than 30 years.

Dr. Massimiano earned his medical degree from Georgetown University School of Medicine. He completed his residency at National Naval Medical Center and did further cardiac surgery training through fellowships at Yale New-Haven Hospital and St. Vincent Heart Institute.

As of May 2026, Dr. Massimiano is no longer with Adventist HealthCare.

title: Leighton Meester | On Gossip Girl, Style & Finding Blair Waldorf | NET-A-PORTER
description:
A video I worked on for NET-A-PORTER featuring Leighton Meester reflecting on Gossip Girl, fashion, and the role that introduced her to audiences worldwide as Blair Waldorf.

Created for PORTER / NET-A-PORTER, the film moves between style memories, character, and the lasting cultural influence of Gossip Girl, with Leighton sharing stories from auditions, wardrobe fittings, and life on set. The tone feels relaxed and conversational while revisiting a series that left a lasting mark on fashion and pop culture.

At the centre of the conversation is Leighton’s memory of auditioning for Gossip Girl in 2007, including the pair of shoes she bought specifically for the callback because they felt right for Blair Waldorf and the world of the Upper East Side. She reflects on how wardrobe became part of shaping the character, and on the experience of stepping into a role so closely associated with fashion and identity.

There’s humour too as she looks back on wedding dresses worn on the show, the surreal experience of filming those scenes, and how people would often respond as if the moment were real. Alongside Gossip Girl, she also talks about taking on newer work including Single Parents, balancing acting and motherhood, and the reality that life rarely feels as neatly balanced as people imagine.

At the time of filming, Leighton Meester remained closely connected to Gossip Girl’s legacy while continuing to build work across television, film, and music. Since then, her work has continued evolving. Most recently she starred opposite Kristen Bell and Adam Brody in Netflix’s Nobody Wants This, which became one of the platform’s biggest comedy releases and brought renewed attention to her work. She also released new music, including the single “Stand By You”, and has continued balancing acting with family life alongside Adam Brody. With Gossip Girl continuing to find new audiences through streaming and social media, Leighton now sits in an interesting place where both longtime viewers and a younger generation are reconnecting with Blair Waldorf while following the newer chapters of her work.

For me, this was part of my work with NET-A-PORTER, contributing to editorial films connecting fashion, culture, and talent through short-form moving image and personality-led storytelling.

title: Mila Kunis | On Parenting, Motherhood & Family Life
description:
A video I worked on for The EDIT, NET-A-PORTER starring Mila Kunis, around the release of A Bad Moms Christmas. The film moves through motherhood, parenting, routines at home, and the reality of raising children, with Mila bringing humour, honesty, and a very grounded perspective throughout.

From conversations about sleep deprivation and the rhythm of family life to parenting advice, daily routines, and sharing responsibilities with Ashton Kutcher, the piece feels open and personal while keeping the energy playful and relaxed. Mila speaks candidly about wanting to raise children she would genuinely like as adults, learning through experience, and trusting your instincts as a parent rather than overthinking every step.

There’s humour throughout, from stories about the things children unexpectedly put in their mouths to moments where Mila and Ashton quietly laugh at the latest word their daughter has picked up. The conversation balances practical parenting with a broader reflection on family life, routine, and figuring things out as you go.

At the time of filming, Mila Kunis was balancing family life alongside major film work including A Bad Moms Christmas, and had become widely recognised both for her acting and for speaking openly about motherhood and everyday life. That honesty comes through here, mixing humour with straightforward reflections in a way that feels warm and relatable.

For me, this was part of my freelance work with NET-A-PORTER, contributing to editorial films connecting fashion, culture, and talent through short-form moving image and personality-led storytelling.

title: TOY STORY 5 TRAILER REACTION TELUGU
description:
Times may change but friends are forever
#ToyStory5​ is only in theaters June 19

An all-new trailer and poster for Disney and Pixar’s highly anticipated upcoming animated adventure “Toy Story 5” debut today. The toys are back and this time, Buzz Lightyear, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they come face-to-face with Lilypad (voice of Greta Lee), a brand-new tablet device that arrives with her own disruptive ideas about what is best for their kid, Bonnie. Will playtime ever be the same?
 
The trailer also teases the anticipated reunion of Woody and Buzz following Woody’s decision to leave the gang and start helping lost toys at the end of 2019’s “Toy Story 4.” As the toys face the tech devices of today, it’s going to be all hands on deck with some familiar and all-new characters.
 
Several actors have joined the incredible roster of voice talent including Craig Robinson as Atlas, a cheerful talking GPS hippo toy; Shelby Rabara as the excitable camera toy Snappy; Scarlett Spears as the sweet and shy 8-year-old Bonnie; Mykal-Michelle Harris as Blaze, an independent 8-year-old girl who loves animals; and Matty Matheson as the tech-fearing toy Dr. Nutcase.
 
Also rounding out the voice cast are John Ratzenberger as the wisecracking piggybank Hamm; Wallace Shawn as Rex, the anxiety-riddled tyrannosaurus rex toy; Blake Clark as the ever-loyal Slinky Dog; Jeff Bergman as the sarcastic Mr. Potato Head; Anna Vocino as the nurturing Mrs. Potato Head; Annie Potts as the adventure-loving Bo Peep; Bonnie Hunt as the wise rag-doll Dolly; Melissa Villaseñor as Karen Beverly, Bonnie’s homemade toy fashioned out of a plastic knife; John Hopkins as the dignified hedgehog plush toy Mr. Pricklepants; Kristen Schaal as the plastic triceratops toy Trixie; Ernie Hudson as the action figure Combat Carl; and Keanu Reeves as Canadian daredevil toy Duke Caboom.
 
The previously announced voice cast includes Tom Hanks (Woody), Tim Allen (Buzz Lightyear), Joan Cusack (Jessie), Greta Lee (Lilypad), Conan O’Brien (Smarty Pants) and Tony Hale (Forky).
 
“Toy Story 5” is directed by Academy Award® winner Andrew Stanton (“WALL•E,” “Finding Nemo,” “Finding Dory”), co-directed by Kenna Harris (“Ciao Alberto”), produced by Lindsey Collins (“Turning Red,” “WALL•E,” “Finding Dory”), and features an original score by Academy Award® winner Randy Newman who returns to score his fifth “Toy Story” feature. The film releases exclusively in theaters nationwide on June 19, 2026. 
 
ABOUT PIXAR:
Pixar Animation Studios, a wholly owned subsidiary of The Walt Disney Company, is an Academy Award®-winning film studio with world-renowned technical, creative and production capabilities in the art of computer animation. The Northern California studio has created some of the most successful and beloved animated films of all time, including “Toy Story,” “Monsters, Inc.,” “Cars,” “The Incredibles,” “Ratatouille,” “WALL•E,” “Up,” “Brave,” “Inside Out,” “Coco,” “Soul,” “Turning Red,” “Elemental,” and “Inside Out 2.”

title: DISCLOSURE DAY MOVIE TRAILER REACTION TELUGU..
description:
Director: Steven Spielberg
Screenplay by: David Koepp
Story by: Steven Spielberg
Producers: Kristie Macosko Krieger and Steven Spielberg
Executive Producers: Adam Somner and Chris Brigham
Cast: Emily Blunt, Josh O’Connor, Colin Firth, Eve Hewson and Colman Domingo

If you found out we weren’t alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you?

This summer, the truth belongs to seven billion people.

We are coming close to … Disclosure Day.

Universal Pictures is proud to release a new original event film created and directed by Steven Spielberg. The film stars SAG winner and Oscar® nominee Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer, A Quiet Place), Emmy and Golden Globe winner Josh O’Connor (Challengers, The Crown), Oscar® winner Colin Firth (The King’s Speech, Kingsman franchise), Eve Hewson (Bad Sisters, The Perfect Couple) and two-time Oscar® nominee Colman Domingo (Sing Sing, Rustin).

Based on a story by Spielberg, the screenplay is by David Koepp, whose previous work with Spielberg includes the scripts for Jurassic Park, The Lost World: Jurassic Park, War of the Worlds and Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Combined, those films earned more than $3 billion worldwide. Koepp also wrote the script for this 2025’s Jurassic World Rebirth.

Disclosure Day is produced by five-time Academy Award® nominee Kristie Macosko Krieger (The Fabelmans, West Side Story) and by Spielberg for Amblin Entertainment. The executive producers are Adam Somner and Chris Brigham.

Steven Spielberg is one of the industry’s most successful and influential filmmakers. The top-grossing director of all time, Spielberg has helmed such blockbusters as Jaws, E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial, the Indiana Jones franchise and Jurassic Park.

Among his myriad honors, he is a three-time Academy Award® winner, including Oscars® for Best Director and Best Picture for Schindler’s List, which received a total of seven Oscars®, and for Best Director for Saving Private Ryan. His most recent film, The Fabelmans, was released by Universal in 2022 and received seven Academy Award® nominations, including for Directing, Best Original Screenplay, Best Actress and Best Picture.

title: How We Filmed a Wedding Day (Behind the Scenes… Kinda Failed 😂)
description:
Spent the day filming Amy & Phil’s wedding and thought we’d try something a bit different… bringing you behind the scenes with us during a real wedding day.

This was our first proper attempt at filming BTS content while also shooting the wedding itself… and honestly, we realised pretty quickly it’s harder than it looks 😂

We definitely missed loads of moments and forgot to film ourselves half the time, but we still managed to capture a few bits throughout the day. Rather than binning the idea completely, we thought we’d upload it anyway and document the process as we improve.

The plan going forward is to create more behind-the-scenes wedding videos at every wedding we film, showing:
• how we work on a real wedding day
• how we capture moments naturally
• how we work together as a husband & wife team
• our filming approach and camera setup
• the chaos, problem solving and real side of wedding videography

We’re still figuring out the best way to shoot BTS whilst actually filming weddings properly. Realistically, we either need to get much better at remembering to film ourselves… or hire a full-time BTS person 😂

Either way, this is the start.

See the finished film from this BTS here;
https://youtu.be/43M9mt86OmM?si=XMs7_bCtIA_VeOTI

If you’re into wedding videography, filmmaking, cameras, behind-the-scenes content, or you’re just curious how wedding films are actually made, hopefully you enjoy following along as we improve these videos over time.

title: My Final Lesson - Toy Photography Behind the Scenes
description:
My Final Lesson, toy photography. 

Nikon D3200
f/7.1
2 sec. exposure
ISO-100
34mm focal length

Hello and welcome back to another behind the scenes toy photography video! This week, I'm going to show you how to shoot from a bird's eye view.

I all this shot: My Final Lesson. 

I'll also show you my editing process!

I didn't have a lot of free time this week, so I wanted to keep my photo as simple as possible. The easiest part of any diorama to make is the ground, so I got the idea to use my ground surface as my backdrop, by shooting my shot from a high angle. 

After covering my desk in a layer of sand, I posed my Boba Fett figure standing upright with a peg stand. Since I was portraying the scene where Boba kills his old mentor, I laid Cad Band down on the ground behind him. 

I then arranged Bane's hat and pistols around him. 

While the characters were in the middle of a wide street in the original scene, I thought the edges of the shot looked a little barren, so I added these crates in strategic places to better frame the shot. 

Sticking to the theme of keeping things simple, I forwent the big fancy lights, and lit this shot with a simple clamping desk lamp. 

Here's my starting image. Since I only used the one small light, my shot was pretty dark. My main goal for the edit was to lighten up the image and add some warmth. 

I began by cropping some of the bottom off the shot then adding adjustment layers for levels and colour balance. I also added a warm photo filter and upped the density. 

Next, I used the healing brush tool to edit out some imperfections in the sand, and to remove the articulation joints on my toys. 

Following that, I used the dodge and burn tools to fine tune the lighting on my subjects. 

Lastly, I added a touch of red glow to Bane's eyes, and painted in the puncture mark on his chest from where Boba stabbed him. 

So, once again, here's where I started. 

And here's where I ended up!

Thank you so much for watching.

title: Diese alten UNO Spiele kennt niemand! | Spielregeln TV - Insider Review Topliste @Mattel @UNO
description:
Du wolltest schon immer mal die TOP SECRET INSIDER TIPPS von einem echten UNO Profi hören? Na dann bist du hier in meinem neuen Video vollkommen richtig! 🥳 In meinem neuen UNO SPECIAL geht es um alte Vintage Retro UNO Spiele die viel zu gut sind, um vergessen zu werden...! Es gibt nämlich sehr viele und wirklich alte Versionen die extrem gut sind und die gleichzeitig aber irgendwie niemand kennt. Aber das ändere ich hiermit! 

Uno (italienisch und spanisch für eins) ist ein US-amerikanisches Kartenspiel, dessen primäres Ziel es ist, seine Karten möglichst schnell abzulegen. Uno ähnelt also Mau-Mau – mit dem Unterschied, dass nicht mit einem regulären Kartenset gespielt wird, sondern mit einem speziellen Blatt. Das Spiel wurde auf der Grundlage einer traditionellen Spielidee bereits 1969 von Merle Robbins (* 1911; † 14. Januar 1984) – einem Inhaber eines Friseursalons in Milford (Ohio) – mit Hilfe seiner Frau Marie, seinem Sohn Ray und dessen Frau Kathy entwickelt. Anfangs wurde es nur in der eigenen Familie gespielt. Mit einem Startkapital von 8000 US-Dollar wurden 1971 in einer ersten Auflage 5000 Spiele produziert, die schnell vergriffen waren. Daraufhin verkaufte er 1972 die Rechte des Spiels für 50.000 US-Dollar plus 10 US-Cent pro verkauftem Spiel an einen Freund, den Besitzer eines Bestattungsunternehmens. Dafür wurde die Firma International Games gegründet, die Uno international vermarktete.

1986 bis 1992 wurde das Spiel in Deutschland von Amigo vertrieben. In Skandinavien wurde es von Spear-Spiele veröffentlicht, eine spanische Version erschien bei Borras Plana. 1992 wurde International Games von Mattel übernommen. Seitdem wird das Spiel in Deutschland von Mattel vertrieben. Und was seither geschah, wissen wir alle nur zu gut...

title: The Lion King Joke That Triggered A Lawsuit
description:
A comedian is being sued for $27 million over a joke about The Lion King.

Lebo M — the composer behind the iconic opening vocals from The Lion King — filed a defamation lawsuit against comedian Learnmore Jonasi after a viral podcast clip in which Jonasi jokingly “translated” the famous "Circle of Life" chant to "Look, there's a lion. Oh my god!"

The legal issue isn’t whether the joke was funny. It’s whether a reasonable audience would understand it as a joke or as a factual statement.

And interestingly, part of Lebo M’s argument is that the clip wasn’t delivered like a stand-up bit or obvious satire. According to the lawsuit, people online actually believed the translation was real.

That’s what makes cases like this complicated.

The First Amendment gives broad protection to comedy, parody, and exaggeration. But if humor starts sounding like factual commentary, the legal analysis changes quickly.

RULES:
The object of the game is to be the first player to complete all 10 phases. The object of each round is to be the first player to play all their cards. Pick a dealer who shuffles and deals 10 cards to each player. Players look at their own cards but keep them hidden from others. Place the remainder of the deck facedown in the middle as a draw deck. Flip the top card over to start a discard pile. Give each player a reference card. The player left of the dealer goes first, then play proceeds clockwise.

On your turn draw 1 card from the top of the draw deck or discard pile and add it to your hand. If you can now lay down a phase face up on the table, you may do so. A phase is a combination of cards as indicated on the reference card. A set is 2 or more cards of the same number. A run is 4 or more cards of the same color in sequential order. All one color is all cards of the same color of any numbers. The reference card indicates what each phases requirements are.

Phases must be made in order, beginning with number 1 and moving up to number 10. You are only allowed to make 1 phase per round, even if the cards meet the requirements for multiple phases simultaneously. To lay down a phase, the phase must be complete, you cannot lay down partial phases. If you lay down a phase in a round, you have completed that phase and will be working towards the next phase in the next round, even if you didn’t win the round. If you fail to make a phase before the round ends, then you must retry that phase in the next round.

After placing down phases, or if you already had your phase played on a previous turn, you may add single cards from your hand that fits any completed phase that is faceup on the table in front of any player. This is called hitting. You may not hit if you have not completed your own phase. 

To end your turn, discard 1 card to the discard pile and the next player clockwise goes. You may not hit with your last card. If you drew the top card of the discard, you are not allowed to discard that same card.

A wild card represents any number of any color. You must have at least 1 number card in a phase, you cannot have a phase entirely of wilds.

Skip cards are discarded in front of other players who do not already have a skip card in front of them. When it is your turn and you have a skip card in front of you, you discard that skip to the discard pile and end your turn, skipping it. Skip cards may never be picked up from the discard nor used in phases. If the first card flipped at the beginning of the round is a skip, then the player left of the dealer skips their turn.

Whenever a player discards their last card in their hand then the round ends and every other player scores points for all their remaining cards in their hand. Mark these on a scoresheet. Gather up the cards and the role of dealer rotates clockwise by one and another round is played with all the players who completed their phase moving onto the next one. Repeat this process until 1 player has completed all 10 phases then they win. If multiple players complete their final phase at the same time, then of those players, the player with the fewest points is the winner. If it is still a tie, then the tied players replay the 10th phase and the first to go out is the winner. Alternatively, you can play with this variation that everyone moves to the next phase after each round and the player with the fewest points after 10 rounds wins.

Har bada sapna ek chhote se decision se shuru hota hai. Jab sab log ruk jaate hain, tab bhi apne goal ke liye kaam karte rehna hi asli discipline hai. Motivation har roz nahi aati, lekin consistency tumhe wahan pahucha sakti hai jahan tum jana chahte ho.
Apne doubts se zyada apni potential par bharosa karo. Aaj ka effort kal ki success ban sakta hai. Chhote steps lo, lekin rukna mat. Har din khud ka ek better version banne ki koshish karo.
Agar tum bhi self-growth, mindset aur success ki journey par ho, to @Nobifit ko follow karo aur is safar ka hissa bano. 🚀

description:
Holi Holi! 💕Yo soy Tiffa y este es mi canal Tiffastudio 😻 aquí podrán ver vídeos muy divertidos donde me enfoco en el  beautystyle  que son mis rutinas de belleza, donde desde mi experiencia les doy tips, y comparto mi opinión de procesos o productos de maquillaje skin care, hair care, cuidado de las uñas, cambios de look y estilo.

También les creo contenido sobre life Style (estilo de vida)  donde podrán ver como intento  tener buenos hábitos, como por ejemplo hacer ejercicio y todo lo que hago para que la vida funcione mejor en cuanto a organización de tiempo y espacios, como me mantengo concentrada, enfocada y productiva, como me proyecto hacia el mundo y por supuesto como priorizo el bienestar. 

Quiero que me acompañen a mis “Tiffaventuras” para también darles algo de entretenimiento, que es donde les revelo mi esencia como una chica que ama experimentar cosas nuevas, viajar, comer, la naturaleza, los animales, compartir en familia, divertirme y obviamente ser super aesthetic y iconic todo el tiempo.

Todo esto se los muestro en forma de tutoriales, videos de conteos, tips,  top,  antes y después, o talvez un haul que es donde muestro y describo varias compras recientes, generalmente ropa, maquillaje u otros productos, o puede ser un unboxing  que es cuando abro y presento un producto nuevo, detallando la experiencia de desempaquetarlo y dando mis primeras impresiones, o quizá un  review, donde analizo y doy mi opinión sobre un producto o servicio después de haberlo probado, aquí me enfoco más en la calidad, ventajas, desventajas, y si recomendaría o no el producto, o mi favorito un Vlog que es donde comparto aspectos de mi vida diaria o experiencias personales. Espero poder darles ratos de entretenimiento, divertirlos, inspirarlos y aportarles algo.
